page_title: LYO 2-3 MAR | Lyon v Marseille 22/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+5' 2 - 3 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
90+4' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is given a fully deserved yellow card.

90+3' 2 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Clinton Mata, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Rayan Cherki (Lyon), who beats Geronimo Rulli with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 2:3.
90+3' The referee is firm and issues Neal Maupay (Marseille) a deserved yellow card.
90+3' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+1' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
88' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) commits a foul and Benoit Bastien immediately signals a free kick.
85' A lofted pass into the box is met by Georges Mikautadze (Lyon), who rifles a shot just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
83' Substitution. Rayan Cherki (Lyon) has come on for Nemanja Matic.
82' 1 - 2 Goal! Pol Lirola produces a great pass that finds Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot high into the net. 1:2.
81' A player from Lyon commits a rough challenge. Benoit Bastien blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
80' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
79' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Luis Henrique is replaced by Neal Maupay (Marseille).
79' A substitution has been made. Mason Greenwood is replaced by Jonathan Rowe (Marseille).
78' A corner kick by Lyon is thwarted by the well prepared Geronimo Rulli (Marseille).
77' Malick Fofana (Lyon) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Lyon earn a corner.
75' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) replaces Abner.
75' Today's match ends for Corentin Tolisso who will be replaced by Malick Fofana (Lyon).
74' Lyon work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
73' Abner (Lyon) takes the corner.
71' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Marseille players have a reason to celebrate!
70' Wait! Referee Benoit Bastien has indicated he is going to review the Marseille goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
69' 1 - 1 Goal! Luis Henrique displays great vision and sends a pass to Pol Lirola (Marseille), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 1:1.
67' Here is a change. Ismael Kone is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Ulisses Garcia (Marseille).
67' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) replacing Jordan Veretout.
67' Alexandre Lacazette will be replaced by Georges Mikautadze (Lyon).

66' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Geronimo Rulli makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
63' A player from Marseille commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
63' The referee awards a corner and Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes over to take it.
61' Lyon are ruled offside.
59' This is a yellow card! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lyon.

58' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Geronimo Rulli guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lyon.

57' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Benoit Bastien with no other option than to blow for a foul.
56' Lyon are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
53' 1 - 0 Clinton Mata produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) rises high to head the ball into the top right corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:0.
53' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

52' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
51' Neat passing move from Lyon in order to create new attacking opportunities.
47' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
46' Roberto De Zerbi has made a change at the break. Pol Lirola (Marseille) has come on in place of Elye Wahi.
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' Benoit Bastien has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+8' Referee Benoit Bastien halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Roberto De Zerbi, then shows him a yellow.

45+7' The rebound finds Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance! The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.

45+7' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom left corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Geronimo Rulli to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
45+6' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+5' The Lyon players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
45+3' There's a break in play and referee Benoit Bastien must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lyon using VAR. This could be interesting!
45+2' Surely that's handball by one of the Marseille players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
45+1' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

43' Ismael Kone (Marseille) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
42' Luis Henrique (Marseille) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
40' Flag up against Elye Wahi (Marseille). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
38' A player from Lyon commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
36' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
34' Lyon fail to score from a corner as Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) leaps to collect the ball.
33' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Lyon.
33' Abner (Lyon) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
31' Lyon control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
30' Abner (Lyon) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Geronimo Rulli, who smothers the ball.
27' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but Geronimo Rulli comes off his line to gather the ball.
25' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

24' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper makes a superb save! The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
23' Benoit Bastien interrupts the game. One of the players from Lyon won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.

22' Lyon seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities. Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 63:37.
20' Abner (Lyon) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
19' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Elye Wahi (Marseille) is flagged for offside.
14' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) makes a strong challenge and Benoit Bastien blows for a foul.
12' Benoit Bastien has a clear sight and sees a foul from Valentin Rongier (Marseille).
11' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Amine Harit will be replaced by Valentin Rongier (Marseille).
10' Gift Orban (Lyon) smashes the ball against the crossbar! What a chance.
10' The corner from Jordan Veretout (Lyon) is hurriedly cleared.
5' RED CARD! Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Benoit Bastien. He can have an early bath.
3' Gift Orban (Lyon) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
1' Gift Orban (Lyon) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' Benoit Bastien shows a yellow card to Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
1' The first half has started.
Lyon will kick the game off.
Benoit Bastien will officiate today.
